m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Your friends are probably close to the breach in the Wheel. Can you get there? I don't know. The Jungle's gone insane.
You can't fly to the breach - the Sky Squids are too angry. But we can lower you down in a basket - talk to Lesal.
I'll make sure Pork finds his way to you. I hope you find them, Wizard - good luck!
Lower you into the Jungle? I can't - the basket and winch were totally sheared away! It was horrible!
We'll have to take my Sky Boat. The Squids are crazy thick, but I'll fly us through them. Hang on!
I only wish the circumstances were better...
I was helping people get to the Streamportal when I caught a fragment of a transmission on my communicator - it was Beans!
I'm going to try to raise him again. Pork to Beans... come in Beans. Come in Beans!
Captain, is that you? It's about darn time!
Calm down, Doctor. Where are you?
I'm hiding in a cave, and Mellori's still with me.
The cave you're in - where is it? The Wizard and I are on our way, but you have to tell us where you are!
Darn it James, I'm a doctor, not a cartographer! The cave's in the jungle! How am I supposed to know? The whole jungle's...
Hang in there, Beans - keep this channel open. We'll find you, just give us some time!
Well, that could have gone better. I have a plan.
Wizard, ask around and find a guide who can get us as close to the Cave of Quickening as possible. Set up this Streamportal in the Jungle.
I've got to get something from Aeriel. I'll catch up!
